events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit, wrangler config, probe
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git branch -r --contains 1ef94a2 | head; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; ls cloud/wrangler* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "name\s*=" cloud/wrangler.toml | head -3; grep -rn "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; head -40 app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs; grep -n "fill\|admin/enter\|ORIGIN\|process.env" app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect wrangler config and scripts
events.input: $ grep -v '^\s*//' cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head -40; cat cloud/package.json | grep -A8 '"scripts"'; ls app/package.json && grep -A12 '"scripts"' app/package.json; git status --short cloud app | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find build and publish scripts
events.input: $ grep -rln "cloud/public" --include=*.sh --include=*.mjs --include=*.py --include=*.md app/scripts cloud scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "tantra-workshop-live" --include=*.sh --include=*.py --include=*.mjs -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find build and publish scripts via git grep

events.text: Checking the deploy chain script before running the Worker deploy and mirror publish.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read run-chain.sh
events.input: $ git diff --stat app/scripts/run-chain.sh; git show HEAD:app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read centre build script and coord log tail
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/build.sh; ls /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md && tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree at origin/main
events.input: $ WT=/tmp/t270-deploy && rm -rf $WT; git worktree add -q --detach $WT origin/main && cd $WT && git log --oneline -1 && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/node_modules cloud/node_modules && ls cloud/public 2>/dev/null | head -3; git merge-base --is-ancestor 1ef94a2 HEAD && echo contains

events.name: Bash
events.head: Build centre static assets in worktree
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t270-deploy && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev > /tmp/t270-build.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -5 /tmp/t270-build.log; ls cloud/public | head; ls cloud/public/onboarding | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Retry build in worktree under home
events.input: $ git worktree remove --force /tmp/t270-deploy; WT=/Users/adithyamurali/t270-deploy; git worktree add -q --detach $WT origin/main && cd $WT && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/node_modules cloud/node_modules && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev > /tmp/t270-build.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -4 /tmp/t270-build.log | cut -c1-300; ls $WT/cloud/public 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect build error and other worktrees
events.input: $ grep -n "Error\|error" /tmp/t270-build.log | head -8 | cut -c1-300; ls -d /Users/adithyamurali/*/app/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign worktree list | head

events.text: The clean-worktree build failed because Turbopack rejects a symlinked node_modules; switching to an APFS clone copy instead.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone node_modules and rebuild centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t270-deploy && rm app/node_modules && time cp -cR /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev > /tmp/t270-build.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -3 /tmp/t270-build.log | cut -c1-300; ls cloud/public 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find ev_length examples
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t270-deploy && grep -n "ev_length" app/src/lib/field-examples.ts app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -6; tail -3 /tmp/t270-build.log | head -1 | cut -c1-200

events.text: Build is good. Deploying the revops-centre Worker from the clean origin/main worktree (approved step).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Deploy revops-centre Worker
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t270-deploy/cloud && npx wrangler deploy > /tmp/t270-deploy.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -i "version id\|Deployed\|error" /tmp/t270-deploy.log | head -5
